content.cast.the-cathedral.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: “把他带回来。把你们自己也带回来。”
content.cast.the-coach-road.absalom-tregear.0.ba: “礼拜堂现在整夜都开着。没人来。”
content.cast.the-fish-market.absalom-tregear.0.b: “小教堂现在整夜开着。没有人来。”
它们夜里从滑道爬上来。当心鱼市。
content.cast.the-harbourmistress.absalom-tregear: 小教堂现在整夜开着。没人来。
content.cast.the-heart.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 把他带回来。你们自己也回来。
content.cast.the-lighthouse.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 要说谁能找到那条老路，也就数灯塔看守人了。
content.cast.the-narrows.ivo-marrack.0.bark.0: 坐进小艇，把住舵。要是我的人还有气，就带回来。
content.cast.the-narrows.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 把他带回来。把你们自己也带回来。
content.cast.the-pier.absalom-tregear.0.bark.0: 你们怎么处置它，我都会写下来。
content.cast.the-rubbing.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 石头是什么，特里加尔会告诉你。需要的话就把他叫醒。
content.cast.the-run.absalom-tregear.0.bark.0: 那边无论出什么事，我都会记下来。
content.cast.the-throat.wenna-coyle.0.bark.0: 把他带回来。你们也回来。
content.class.physician.blurb: 支援。向队伍投掷治疗喷溅药水；配剑和轻皮甲。
content.class.physician.name: 医师
content.class.reporter.blurb: 远程。后排用弩，近身用剑，还有望远镜观察。
content.class.reporter.name: 记者
content.class.scholar.blurb: 轻装战士。剑、皮甲锁甲，还有清理旧石刻的刷子。
content.class.scholar.kit.5.name: 学者之刷
content.class.scholar.name: 学者
content.class.veteran.blurb: 前排。剑盾重铁甲：慢，但极难杀死。
content.class.veteran.name: 老兵
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-carvers.text: 一个没人记得的民族，比这座镇子还早。第二块石板下面有一行他们自己的文字。我一直读不懂。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-panels.text: 人们把石头砸进它的脑袋。然后探海者睡着，做梦，梦漫到岸上。然后人们抬起石头，探海者沉入海沟。抬起石头，就是把它送下去。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-row.text: 最下面那排。在我祖父之前就断掉了。我不知道上面刻的是什么。这比其他部分更让我害怕。
content.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-rubbing.text: 文娜让你们来的。那我就告诉你们。这是拓片：我祖父从额石上取下来的，就是钉进探海者脑袋里、刻满花纹的那块石头。那块石头底部断掉了。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.opt.0.label: 她在等你。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.text: 我不知道怎么到这儿的。我什么都不记得了。我母亲没事吧？
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.0.label: 戴维。你妈妈。
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.1.label: 醒醒，戴维
content.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.text: 戴维睁着眼睛站在心脏旁边。“这里很暖和。它在做梦，我们也梦着它。心脏回应着苏醒的伤口；伤口只出现在外面，从不会在这里。躺到它旁边吧。时间快到了。”
content.dlg.davey-home.davey-home.text: “我不记得那间公寓，别的也都不记得了。妈妈说你大老远专程来找我。谢谢你。”
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.opt.0.label: 怎么过去？
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.text: 那你们是要进里面去。我进去过。口子在低处开着。我带了两个人进去，一个人出来，他们还在里面。不知道他们是死是活。
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.opt.0.tool: 马拉克把小船借给你，把他的日志也给了你。
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.text: “我的小艇在路尽头的老渡屋里。坐进去，手搭在舵上；它会沿着自己的缆线过水。要是你被落下，就摇门边的铃。也带上我的航海日志；上面记着我见到的。要找到我的人，就把他们带出来。”
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.opt.0.label: 我们在找一个男孩
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.text: “伊沃·马拉克。彭哈洛来的，干打捞的。三天前坐船来，要在别人之前把那东西剥了。”
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.0.label: 我们在找一个男孩
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.1.label: 你是谁？
content.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.text: “又一群冲着尸体来的？掉头回去。”他正眼看了看你。“……不。你们不是来打捞的。”
content.dlg.sleeper-lofts.sleeper-lofts.text: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-ropewalk.sleeper-ropewalk.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-street-1.sleeper-street-1.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.sleeper-street-2.sleeper-street-2.te: 沉睡的人没醒。闭着眼，面朝大海，低声呓语。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.text: 现在拉克姆每个人都做同样的梦。你走上泥滩，躺在它旁边。然后睡着的人就真的做了。天亮时，我们大都在水边找到他们。三个人走进了水里。戴维就是其中之一。我怕那个梦。我不敢睡。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-fathomer.text: “这是拉克姆的老叫法，指海湾外海沟里睡着的那个东西。他们说它头里有块石头。教堂里的阿布萨隆·特雷加尔知道那是什么石头。去问他。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.0.label: 探渊者？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.1.label: 返回
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.text: “四天前的夜里，海湾底翻了上来。两英里长的黑泥，正好横在港口入口。有个东西跟着一起升上来，在远处的边缘。有一座小山那么大。老人们叫它探渊者。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.0.label: 滩涂上有什么？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.1.label: 在睡梦中？
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.2.label: 我们会找到他。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.text: “你们来了。好。我是温娜·科伊尔，港务长。我在报纸上登了启事。四天前夜里，我儿子戴维在睡梦中走上滩涂，再没回来。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.label: 留着它
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.tooltip: 特雷加尔把石头锁进教堂地窖，谁也再不能把它放回去。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.label: 还回去
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.tooltip: 石头从码头尽头落入海中，回到它来的地方。
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.text: “你把他带回来了。”她抓着戴维的胳膊不放。“那块石头。特雷加尔说，要是它回到海里，那东西就会沉回去。要是你们留着，就谁也再放不回去了。你们说了算。”
content.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-slipway.text: “灯已经点亮了。那就是古道；人们说它不会陷下去。顺着木桩走到黑水那边。把他带回来。”
content.fx.marrack.oc.the-pillars.1.narrate: 石柱上的雕刻比那张拓片更清晰：人们把一块碑打进沉睡的巨首；头颅做梦；人们抬起碑，巨物沉入深海。下面有一行小记号，这里没人能读。
content.fx.the-cathedral.oc.the-shore.0.narrate: 黑水潭岸边：两盏打捞灯，已熄灭；一只靴子；一卷绳子；两件空油布衣，并排摆着，好像有人打算回来取。
content.fx.the-coach-road.oc.the-notice.1.narrat: 驿站候车棚里钉着的告示：“我儿子戴维·科伊尔四天前的夜里梦游走上了新滩涂，至今没有回来。谁能把他带回家，我必有重谢。请到拉克姆港务局询问。港务长温娜·科伊尔。”
content.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chart.0.narr: 这张海图比镇子还老：一条跨过海湾的路，朝圣者之路，一路有木桩标记。页边写着：灯塔的灯曾经照亮这些木桩。
content.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chip.0.seq.1: 有那么一会儿，你走在温热的黑泥上，想在某样东西旁边躺下。
content.fx.the-fish-market.oc.the-market-slate.0: 鱼市的价格板，粉笔写着：沙丁鱼、鲭鱼、鳕鱼，以及四天前的日期。下面有人用大字写了三遍“低”。
content.fx.the-narrows.oc.the-chalk-arrow.1.narr: 一颗牙上有个粉笔箭头，指向嘴里。箭头下边，同样用粉笔写着：“伊·马及两人。”
content.fx.the-pier.done.0.seq.1.0.narrate: 那晚拉克姆没有人做梦。特雷吉尔没有睡：石头在他礼拜堂下做梦，他听得见。
content.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-shipwright-no: 造船匠的字条：滩涂隆起那晚封住了港口入口，现在没有船能离开拉克姆。远侧唯一的船是一位叫马拉克的船长的打捞艇，他三天前从海上来。
content.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-spade.1.narra: 剥鲸铲：一把捕鲸人的长刀，锋利得能从肉里剜出石头。
content.fx.the-wreck-field.oc.the-nameboard.0.na: 一艘侧躺在泥里的船壳，船名牌的漆几乎掉光：莫温娜号，拉克姆。船头的挂架上还挂着一口钟。
content.fx.trig.customs-door.0.narrate: 锁着。需要海关楼的钥匙。
content.fx.trig.diaphragm-sealed.0.narrate: 坚韧的膜。需要一把长而锋利的刀。
content.fx.trig.rubbing-script.0.narrate: 第二块镶板下有一排小刻痕，用的是一种拉克姆没人能读的文字。
content.fx.trig.slipway-sealed.0.narrate: 台阶过去的泥会吞掉靴子。黑暗中没人能找到那边的老路。
content.fx.trig.spine-sealed.0.narrate: 心脏跳动时，这里紧闭着。
content.fx.trig.wool-picture.0.narrate: 戴维的画，用彩色羊毛织成：满月下，一个黑色的形体躺在黑泥上，一个小小的人影朝它走去。

content.quest.marrack.goal: 在打捞船长的船旁与他会面，取走他的航海日志并借用他的小艇，然后穿过雕刻石柱。
content.quest.the-brow.goal: 沿脊柱攀上头顶，切下眉骨石。
content.quest.the-cathedral.goal: 穿过肋骨大教堂，切开横膈膜，到达胃部。
content.quest.the-coach-road.goal: 到达马车道，选择你的身份，俯瞰拉克姆和泥滩。
content.quest.the-customs-house.goal: 用女港务长的钥匙打开海关：取旧路海图和石头碎片。
content.quest.the-fish-market.goal: 击退从滑道上来的溺尸，守住鱼市。
content.quest.the-harbourmistress.goal: 找到在报纸上登启事的女港务长，听她讲述镇上正经历的事。
content.quest.the-heart.goal: 找到心脏旁的戴维，用三个瓣膜让心脏停跳。
content.quest.the-lighthouse.goal: 点亮灯塔，让旧路的灯标照亮泥滩路，然后下到滑道阶梯。
content.quest.the-narrows.goal: 穿过海峡，乘小艇渡过黑水，到达身体的颌部。
content.quest.the-pier.goal: 在码头上决定如何处置眉骨石。
content.quest.the-rubbing.goal: 让镇上的档案员在海员礼拜堂解读眉骨石拓片。
content.quest.the-run.goal: 跑过背部和河岸，到小艇处，与戴维一起渡水，然后沿堤道走回家。
content.quest.the-shut-harbour.goal: 弄清为什么船都出不了港，从捕鲸人小屋拿走剥脂铲。
content.quest.the-throat.goal: 找到离开无尽喉咙的路。
content.quest.the-wreck-field.goal: 沿朝圣者之路走出去，在沉船场击退溺尸。
content.world.boundary.message: 雾太浓，无法继续前进。你原路返回。
content.world.title: 搁浅

source.class.physician.blurb: Support. Throws splash potions of healing over the party; a sword and light leather armour.
source.class.physician.name: Physician
source.class.reporter.blurb: Ranged fighter. A crossbow from behind the line, a sword for close work, and a spyglass for looking.
source.class.reporter.name: Reporter
source.class.scholar.blurb: Light fighter. A sword, leather and chain armour, and a brush for old carvings.
source.class.scholar.kit.5.name: Scholar's Brush
source.class.scholar.name: Scholar
source.class.veteran.blurb: Front-line fighter. Sword, shield and heavy iron armour: slow, and very hard to kill.
source.class.veteran.name: Veteran
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-carvers.text: "A people nobody remembers, before the town. Under the second panel there's a line in their own script. I've never been able to read it."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-panels.text: "People driving the stone into its head. Then the Fathomer asleep, and dreaming, and the dream reaching the shore. Then the stone lifted, and the Fathomer going down into the trench. That's what lifting the stone does: it sends it down."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-row.text: "The bottom row. It was broken off before my grandfather's time. I don't know what it showed. That frightens me more than the rest of it."
source.dlg.absalom-tregear.tregear-rubbing.text: "Wenna sent you. Then I'll tell you. This is the Rubbing: my grandfather took it from a piece of the Brow Stone, the carved stone that's driven into the Fathomer's head. The bottom of it is broken off."
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.opt.0.label: She's waiting.
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-awake.text: "I don't know how I got here. I don't remember any of it. Is my mother all right?"
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.0.label: Davey. Your mother.
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.opt.1.label: Wake up, Davey.
source.dlg.davey-coyle.davey-dream.text: Davey stands by the heart with his eyes open. "It's warm here. It's dreaming, and we dream it. The heart answers the wound that wakes; the wound shows itself outside, never in here. Lie down beside it. It's nearly time."
source.dlg.davey-home.davey-home.text: "I don't remember the flat, or any of it. Mother says you came a long way for me. Thank you."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.opt.0.label: How do we get across?
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-boy.text: "Then you're going inside. I went in. The mouth's open at the low end. I took two men in with me and I came out alone, and they're still in there. I don't know if they're alive."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.opt.0.tool: Marrack lends you his skiff and gives you his log.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-skiff.text: "My skiff's in the old ferry house at the end of the road. Sit in it and put a hand to the tiller; it crosses on its own line. If you get left behind, ring the bell by the door. Take my log too; it's what I saw. If you find my men, bring them out."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.opt.0.label: We're looking for a boy.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack-who.text: "Ivo Marrack. Salvage, out of Penhallow. Came by sea three days ago to strip the thing before anyone else could."
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.0.label: We're looking for a boy.
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.opt.1.label: Who are you?
source.dlg.ivo-marrack.marrack.text: "Another crew after the carcass? Turn round." He looks at you properly. "...No. You're not salvage."
source.dlg.sleeper-lofts.sleeper-lofts.text: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-ropewalk.sleeper-ropewalk.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-street-1.sleeper-street-1.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.sleeper-street-2.sleeper-street-2.te: The sleeper doesn't wake. Eyes shut, facing the sea, murmuring.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-dream.text: "Everyone in Wrackham dreams the same dream now. You walk out on the mud and lie down beside it. And then people do it, asleep. Most of them we find at dawn standing at the edge of the water. Three walked into it. Davey is one of the three. I'm afraid of that dream. I'm afraid to sleep."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-fathomer.text: "An old Wrackham name for what sleeps in the trench off the bay. There's a stone in its head, they say. Absalom Tregear at the chapel knows what the stone is. Ask him."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.0.label: The Fathomer?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-flat.text: "Four nights ago the bottom of the bay came up. Two miles of black mud, right across the harbour mouth. And something came up with it, out at the far edge. It's the size of a hill. The old people call it the Fathomer."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.0.label: What is out on the flat?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.1.label: In his sleep?
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.opt.2.label: We'll find him.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-hire.text: "You came. Good. I'm Wenna Coyle, harbourmistress; I put the notice in the papers. My son Davey walked out onto the flat four nights ago in his sleep and didn't come back."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.label: Keep it.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.0.tooltip: Tregear locks the stone in the chapel crypt, where nobody can ever put it back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.label: Give it back.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.opt.1.tooltip: The stone goes off the end of the pier, into the sea it came from.
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-pier.text: "You brought him back." She has hold of Davey's arm and doesn't let go. "That stone. Tregear says if it goes back in the sea, the thing goes back down. If you keep it, nobody can ever put it back. It's yours to say."
source.dlg.wenna-coyle.wenna-slipway.text: "The lamps are lit. That's the old road; it doesn't sink, they say. Follow the stakes out to the black water. Bring him back."
source.fx.marrack.oc.the-pillars.1.narrate: Carved in the pillar, sharper than the Rubbing: people driving a tablet into a vast sleeping head; the head dreaming; the tablet lifted, and the creature going down into the deep. Under it, a line of small marks nobody here can read.
source.fx.the-cathedral.oc.the-shore.0.narrate: On the shore of the black pool: two salvage lamps, gone out; a boot; a coil of rope; two oilskin coats, empty, laid side by side as if someone meant to come back for them.
source.fx.the-coach-road.oc.the-notice.1.narrat: The notice, pinned in the coach shelter: "My son Davey Coyle walked out onto the new flat in his sleep four nights ago and has not come back. I will pay whoever brings him home. Ask at the Harbour Office, Wrackham. Wenna Coyle, harbourmistress."
source.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chart.0.narr: The chart is older than the town: a road across the bay, the Pilgrims' Way, marked by stakes all the way out. A note in the margin says the lighthouse lamp once lit them.
source.fx.the-customs-house.oc.the-chip.0.seq.1: For a moment you are walking out over warm black mud, and you want to lie down beside something.
source.fx.the-fish-market.oc.the-market-slate.0: The fish market's price slate, in chalk: pilchard, mackerel, ling, and the date four days ago. Under it someone has written LOW in large letters, three times.
source.fx.the-narrows.oc.the-chalk-arrow.1.narr: A chalk arrow on a tooth, pointing into the mouth. Under it, in the same chalk: "I.M. and two".
source.fx.the-pier.done.0.seq.1.0.narrate: Nobody in Wrackham dreams that night. Tregear does not sleep: under his chapel the stone dreams, and he hears it.
source.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-shipwright-no: The shipwright's note: the flat closed the harbour mouth the night of the rising, and no boat goes out of Wrackham now. The only boat on the far side is the salvage launch of a captain called Marrack, who came by sea three days ago.
source.fx.the-shut-harbour.oc.the-spade.1.narra: The Flensing Spade: a long whaler's blade, sharp enough to cut a stone out of flesh.
source.fx.the-wreck-field.oc.the-nameboard.0.na: The name board of a hull lying on its side in the mud, the paint nearly gone: MORWENNA, WRACKHAM. A bell is still in its mount at the bow.
source.fx.trig.customs-door.0.narrate: Locked. You need the Customs House key.
source.fx.trig.diaphragm-sealed.0.narrate: Tough membrane. It needs a long, sharp blade.
source.fx.trig.far-door-sealed.0.narrate: The door is barred from inside.
source.fx.trig.far-tiller.0.seq.1.2.sealed_hint: The ferry house is shut. Ring the bell beside the door.
source.fx.trig.near-tiller.0.seq.1.1.sealed_hin: The ferry house is shut. Ring the bell beside the door.
source.fx.trig.rubbing-script.0.narrate: A line of small carved marks under the second panel, in a script nobody in Wrackham can read.
source.fx.trig.slipway-sealed.0.narrate: The mud past the stair swallows a boot. Nobody could find the old road out there in the dark.
source.fx.trig.spine-sealed.0.narrate: Shut tight while the heart beats.
source.fx.trig.the-coach-stop.0.seq.0.1.narrate: a fishing town on Wrack Bay
source.fx.trig.wool-picture.0.narrate: Davey's picture, worked in coloured wool: a black shape lying on black mud under a full moon, and a small figure walking out to it.

source.quest.marrack.goal: Meet the salvage captain at his launch, take his log and the use of his skiff, and pass the carved pillars.
source.quest.the-brow.goal: Climb the spine to the top of the head and cut the Brow Stone out.
source.quest.the-cathedral.goal: Cross the Rib Cathedral, cut through the diaphragm and reach the stomach.
source.quest.the-coach-road.goal: Arrive on the coach road, choose who you are, and look down on Wrackham and the flat.
source.quest.the-customs-house.goal: Open the Customs House with the harbourmistress's key: the chart of the old road, and the chip of the stone.
source.quest.the-fish-market.goal: Fight off the Drowned coming up the slipway into the fish market.
source.quest.the-harbourmistress.goal: Find the harbourmistress who put the notice in the papers, and hear what the town is living through.
source.quest.the-heart.goal: Find Davey by the heart, and stop the heart with the three valves.
source.quest.the-lighthouse.goal: Light the lighthouse lamp, so the old road's lamps show the way across the flat, and go down to the slipway stair.
source.quest.the-narrows.goal: Cross the Narrows, take the skiff over the black water, and reach the jaw of the body.
source.quest.the-pier.goal: Decide on the pier what to do with the Brow Stone.
source.quest.the-rubbing.goal: Have the town archivist read the Rubbing of the Brow Stone in the Seamen's Chapel.
source.quest.the-run.goal: Run the back and the bank to the skiff, cross with Davey, and walk the causeway home.
source.quest.the-shut-harbour.goal: Learn why no boat can leave the harbour, and take the Flensing Spade from the Whalers' Shed.
source.quest.the-throat.goal: Find the way out of the endless throat.
source.quest.the-wreck-field.goal: Walk out on the Pilgrims' Way and fight through the Drowned in the wreck field.
source.world.boundary.message: The fog is too thick to go further. You find your way back.
source.world.title: The Stranding
